outcome: neonatal outcomes (birth weight, sex, birth defects, singleton vs. twins, mode of delivery)
cohort: 139 patients who underwent in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) between January 2011 and December 2014.
finding: Among patients with adenomyosis, those who received GnRH agonist therapy before frozen-thawed embryo transfer had a significantly higher live birth rate compared to those who received hormone replacement therapy alone.
